- Overestimate prices after sentiment spikes (especially >0.6) — model tends to overshoot in bullish sentiment phases.
- Underestimate prices during prolonged negative sentiment (sentiment <0.4) — model fails to capture downward momentum.
- Lag in price correction after sharp spikes — model delays reaction to true price reversals.
- Mean reversion bias: model overreacts to recent volatility, underestimating reversion to prior mean.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts consistently overestimate later periods (e.g., 25–30 days) when sentiment is neutral or mildly bullish.
- Avoid extrapolating sentiment trends beyond 3–5 days — sentiment decay often underestimates model’s lagged response.
